findings.title: Trace cells carry uniform current through the full 0.3 mm Cu thickness at 20 MHz; the docstring's claim that bar internal inductance is 'neglected' is false
findings.detail: The Hoer-Love uniform-current self and image mutuals put each bar's current at the mid-thickness of the copper. That means the bars keep their full DC internal inductance: current is not pushed toward the face nearest the backside Cu, even though skin depth is about 15 µm against t = 0.3 mm. The module docstring says the opposite ('the bar internal inductance is neglected (delta << t)'). As a result the trace contribution to L does not depend on frequency and is biased high. The bias differs by family, so cross-family ranking can shift slightly. The planned L2 reference (research/notes/o001-l2-reference.md) layers filaments through the thickness down to δ/2, so this bias will appear directly in E002's MAPE, where criterion A4 allows at most 12%.
findings.evidence: 18 layouts (seed 31337) at 20 MHz, compared with the same layouts where top Cu is thinned to 0.03 mm (a current sheet at the bottom face). L(0.3 mm)/L(sheet) − 1: side_by_side +6.1..+8.5%, interleaved +11.9..+13.2%, u_shaped +11.7..+12.4%. Within-family Spearman ρ between the two: 1.000 / 1.000 / 0.964.
findings.suggested_check: Correct the docstring, and either split the bars into 2–3 thickness layers or state the expected HF bias in the pre-registered E002 analysis.

findings.title: Loop inductance is not mesh-converged at the default hmax = 4 mm, and the convergence test is too loose to detect it
findings.detail: The refinement sequence is not monotone and not clearly converging. The 2 mm vs 1 mm gap stays as large as the 4 mm vs 2 mm gap, so 1 mm is not converged either. The unit test only asks for mid within 10% of fine (with fine = 2 mm), which would pass a clearly unconverged answer. The approximation tiers were ruled out as the cause: forcing exact Hoer-Love for every pair changes L by only −0.16..−0.71%. Rankings within a family hold up (ρ 0.965–0.993), so for O001 this is mainly an absolute-accuracy (MAPE) risk.
findings.evidence: L at 20 MHz for hmax 8/4/2/1 mm, in nH. u_shaped n=5: 10.993/10.424/10.052/9.656. side_by_side n=4: 3.886/4.014/4.014/3.846. Over 36 layouts (12 per family, seed 555), L(4 mm)/L(1 mm) − 1 has mean +4.0..+6.1% and max +10.7%. Spearman ρ(4 mm, 1 mm) per family: 0.965 / 0.993 / 0.993.
findings.suggested_check: Report L at 4/2/1/0.5 mm on a few layouts with a Richardson estimate, and tighten the test tolerance to what the mesh actually achieves.

findings.title: Splitting a bond wire into segments inflates its self-inductance at realistic radii; the author's additivity test avoids that regime
findings.detail: Each segment's self-inductance uses Grover's round-wire form, i.e. a filament mutual at distance a. Touching neighbouring segments of the same wire, however, are coupled as zero-radius filaments (d ≈ 1e-12). At the model's a/l_seg of about 0.1–0.25 the sum over segments exceeds the self-inductance of the unsplit wire. test_segment_mutual_touching_collinear_segments_finite_and_additive uses a = 10 µm, where this error vanishes, so it does not test the regime the model actually runs in.
findings.evidence: Straight wire split into 6 segments with the model's own _seg_matrix plus Grover diagonal, compared with Grover self of the whole wire. a = 0.15 mm: +4.45% / +2.50% / +1.53% at 5 / 8 / 12 mm length. a = 0.20 mm: +6.36% / +3.55% / +2.17%.
findings.suggested_check: Compute the mutual between touching segments of the same wire at distance a (consistent with the GMD), and rerun the additivity test with a = 0.15–0.2 mm.

findings.title: Skin-corrected bar resistance counts internal cell side walls as skin surfaces, so R(f) does not converge under refinement
findings.detail: The perimeter skin-layer formula A_eff = wt − (w − 2δ)(t − 2δ) is applied to every PEEC cell. For cells inside a trace this counts the two shared side walls as current-carrying surfaces. Total A_eff therefore grows with the number of cells across a trace, and R keeps falling as the mesh is refined, at an accelerating rate. R_ohm is a reported output and 'skin-corrected R' is a named deliverable, but it is not an O001 acceptance metric.
findings.suggested_check: Apply the skin layer only to exposed trace faces (top and bottom, plus true polygon edges), or flag R_ohm as mesh-dependent.

findings.title: The 50 ms median timing limit passes with a machine-dependent margin
findings.detail: The benchmark passed at p50 39.5 ms (p90 56.5 ms), and at p50 32.7 ms in a repeat run. CPU/wall ratio was 1.00, which confirms the thread pinning works (numpy 2.5.3 with Accelerate). A mixed set of die counts gives p50 25.1 ms. The headroom is 20–35% on this machine and could shrink on slower CI hardware.
findings.evidence: benchmarks/l1_timing.py printed l1_eval_ms_p50=39.50 l1_eval_ms_p90=56.46. In the independent re-run, wall p50 was 32.7 ms and CPU p50 32.6 ms.
findings.suggested_check: Record CPU model and numpy BLAS in the E003 run metadata.

findings.title: The infinite-image-plane assumption is weakest at the substrate edge
findings.detail: Traces start at y = 1.5 mm while the backside Cu begins at 1.0 mm (a 1 mm inset). The trace edge is therefore only about 0.5 mm from the edge of the image plane, at a height of roughly 0.5 mm. Image theory is least accurate there. This is documented as neglected and is consistent with the hypothesis.
findings.evidence: halfbridge.Y_BOT = 1.5 mm; Layout.backside_inset = 1.0 mm; the image is at z_top(backside_cu), 0.53 mm below the mid-plane of the top Cu.
findings.suggested_check: Include edge-adjacent layouts in E002 residual analysis (failure mode F3).

independent_checks_performed: Ran every definition-of-done command. pytest: 30 passed. ruff: clean. No L2 import: ok. End-to-end seed-7 check: L = [10.115, 10.097, 10.089] nH at 5/20/80 MHz, finite and monotone. Benchmark: p50 39.5 ms, exit 0.

Hoer-Love superposition identities in touching configurations, which no author test covers: width, length and thickness splits, a 2×2 corner-touching split, a split bar against its image, and a 0.1 mm sliver split. All hold to ≤2.3e-13 relative.

End-to-end image plus parallel-network check against a published formula: a 50 mm × 6 mm thin strip at 0.385 mm above the backside-Cu image, 40 cosine-graded lanes, using the model's _bar_block. Result 3.277 nH vs 3.330 nH from Hammerstad microstrip (εr = 1), a −1.6% difference.
Approximation-tier accuracy: forced exact Hoer-Love for all bar, image and segment pairs. L at 20 MHz changes by −0.20..−0.71% at 4 mm and −0.16..−0.23% at 2 mm.
Mesh-convergence study (hmax 8/4/2/1 mm) on 9 mixed layouts, plus within-family rank stability on 36 layouts. Bias +4..+6% on average, up to +10.7%. ρ 0.965–0.993.

Passivity and SPD on 8 layouts at 4 mm and 2 mm: L, L − M_img(backside) and L − M_img(baseplate) are all SPD, with minimum eigenvalue ≥1.9e-11 H and asymmetry ≤4e-25. Over 15 layouts across 10 kHz–316 MHz: R > 0, R increasing and L non-increasing in f, with no violations.
Single-core timing check: CPU time equals wall time (ratio 1.00), p50 32.7 ms on 36 layouts with 6 dies per switch; p50 25.1 ms on 60 mixed layouts.
Trace-thickness sensitivity: L with a 0.3 mm uniform-current trace vs a 0.03 mm bottom-face sheet, on 18 layouts. L is 6–13% higher with uniform current, and the size of the gap depends on family.
Bond-wire segmentation additivity at the model's radii (0.15–0.2 mm): split wires come out +1.5..+6.4% above the unsplit wire.
Resistance under mesh refinement: R falls 6.7–11.8% from 4 mm to 1 mm, with larger steps at finer meshes.
caveats: Holds as an implementation of the O001 L1 hypothesis (uniform-current rectangular cells, skin-corrected R only, Grover wires, ideal infinite image planes). It is not a converged or unbiased estimate of loop inductance. At default settings, absolute L is likely 5–15% high against a reference with thickness-resolved, converged meshing, and that gap bears on criterion A4 (MAPE ≤ 12%).
Rankings within a family are stable under mesh refinement (ρ ≥ 0.965). Cross-family ordering is dominated by large gaps between families (about 4 vs 8–13 nH) in the samples tested.
The timing result was reproduced only on this machine (Apple Accelerate BLAS). The 50 ms median has 20–35% headroom here.
R_ohm depends on the mesh and should not be used quantitatively without fixing how interior side walls are handled.
Scratch work had to be run as inline scripts because file writes to /tmp were blocked. No L2 solver is in the repository, so L1 could not be compared against it.
